examples: All external sources live in packages/ingest/src/adapters/* implementing SourceAdapter.
Normalize through upsertEvents / upsertShowtimes — never write source-specific SQL in the API.
New cities or sources = new adapter + schedule entry.
Web and future iOS only talk to apps/api /v1/*.
Keep ranking in @bored/shared so clients stay thin.
Event and showtime ticket/register links use GET /r/e/:id and /r/s/:id — never raw third-party URLs in primary CTAs.
Affiliate + UTM rewriting lives in packages/shared/src/affiliate.ts; destinations always resolve from DB.
Run one supervised stack: pnpm dev (scripts/dev.sh) — frees :3000/:4000, auto-restarts on crash.
After .env changes: pnpm dev:restart. Do not spawn multiple dev:api tabs.
After API/ingest/shared/db changes that need a restart: restart :4000 yourself (kill port, pnpm dev:api, curl /health) — do not ask the user.
Don't commit or git add until explicitly asked.
